Bihar MLC Polls: RJD and Congress Clash Over Seat Allocation

Ahead of the Bihar Legislative Council (MLC) polls, a rift has emerged between allies Rashtriya Janata Dal (RJD) and Congress over seat allocation. The Congress announced candidates for five seats, while the RJD is contesting three of those same seats, indicating a face-off on at least four constituencies.
